title: Primer of the Set Mind
summary: A first primer on fixing the mind on one point before the body moves so that strike and guard and step land where the mind was set.

title: First Course in Resolve
summary: A first course that teaches the student to refuse to give way and to turn that refusal into a blow and a guard.

title: The Plain Vow Primer
summary: A plain primer on speaking a short vow before each act so that the body keeps the promise the mouth has made.

title: Primer of Steady Intent
summary: A primer on holding one intent through a whole movement so that the force of will does not drift from its mark.

title: The Unmoved Stance Course
summary: A course in standing so firmly by will alone that blows spend themselves on a body that will not be moved.

title: Manual of the Fixed Purpose
summary: A short manual on choosing one purpose and letting every move of the body serve it and nothing else.

title: Basic Book of Command
summary: A basic book on giving a command with the whole will behind it so that bodies and nerves answer the voice.

title: Primer of the Quiet Insistence
summary: A primer on the patient will that never raises its voice and never lets go of the thing it has asked for.
